name: Bongani Adams
headline: Junior Mine Planning Engineer | South African Mining Industry | Proficient in mine design, resource estimation, and production planning tools
summary: Junior Mine Planning Engineer with 2 years of hands-on experience in mine design, resource modeling, and production planning. Proven track record in reducing operational costs and improving planning accuracy using industry-standard tools. Based in Johannesburg, South Africa.

bullets: Designed a 3D mine layout for a gold project in Limpopo using MineSight, achieving 95% alignment with geological data and reducing drilling costs by 18%.
Built a haul road network in AutoCAD and validated it with GIS data, cutting transport time by 15% and improving vehicle routing efficiency by 22%.
Developed a production schedule in MinePlan for a nickel operation, achieving 98% adherence and reducing overruns by 12% over 10 months.
Performed resource block modeling using GOCAD and Surfer, improving grade estimation accuracy from 72% to 89% for a 300,000-tonne deposit.
Integrated drilling data into MineSight, reducing data entry errors by 40% and improving planning precision by 30%.
Conducted a feasibility study for a new open-cut operation using Excel and Python, identifying a 14% reduction in initial capital costs.
Collaborated with geologists to create a 3D geological model for a platinum project, improving grade prediction accuracy by 28% at 100m depth.
